text:
kevin: Quick sync — trying to land PR #13288 (serve:kv-fix). Targets: reduce KV cache mem leak; low-risk change. Need 2 approvals + CI green. Deploy freeze starts 2026-03-01 00:00 UTC so I'd like to merge by 2026-02-29 18:00 PT. ping @maria @jon
maria: I can review today afternoon PT. Will focus on the allocator change and tests.
jon: I'll give an approval after the macOS runner is stable. Saw a flaky failure in `torch-smoke-test`.
ci-bot: GH Actions: build #13288.5 failed on macos-latest — `tests/smoke/test_torch.py::test_torch_load` (log: https://ci/repo/13288/5)
kevin: thanks. The macos failure is nondeterministic on the GPU image; I isolated a potential timing issue in the fixture. I pushed a small test tweak in a follow-up commit to reduce flakiness.
maria: looked at the diff, small tweak LGTM. Leaving a comment about a clearer assertion message.
jon: rerun macos job? I kicked it off: https://ci/repo/13288/6
ci-bot: GH Actions: build #13288.6 passed on macos-latest. All checks green except nightly-performance (optional)
kevin: OK excellent. Two approve requests out in GH. @maria @jon can you press the green button when you have a sec? Need to coordinate merges so we don't bump into the freeze.
sre-oncall: FYI infra maintenance on 2026-03-01 00:00 UTC will begin network upgrade; any merges after 2026-02-29 19:30 PT may be delayed. If you need earlier, consider a canary flag off so no deploy happens during freeze.
maria: approved ✅ merging after Jon gives final thumbs up.
jon: approved ✅. I'll merge and monitor canary metrics for 30min post-merge. If something looks off we can rollback.
kevin: merging now. Thanks all :tada:
ci-bot: GH Actions: merge of PR #13288 completed. Deploy queued to canary pool (no immediate rollout due to freeze flag).
